hint: consider the coin denominations in a fixed order and, for each denomination, try every possible count of that coin before recursing on the remaining denominations. Fixing the order prevents counting the same multiset of coins as several ordered sequences. Results are memoized on (amount, denomination index). Examples: count_repr(0) -> 1 (the empty selection) count_repr(5) -> 2 count_repr(10) -> 4 count_repr(25) -> 13 count_repr(100) -> 242
